It's been a while since I arrived, but I no longer feel that initial uneasiness.
And it seems like they don't mind me being here... They even seem to like it.
No, no, I shouldn't think about that. I need to remember that this is work.
“Let's head to our rooms and sleep. We have to wake up early tomorrow.”
I was half asleep earlier, so I didn't notice, but now I realize that the kitchen light is on.
I remember checking before going to bed and making sure all the power was turned off.
Out of curiosity, I quietly walk over to see who's in the kitchen.
“I'm sorry, let's just pretend I didn't say anything...”
“I know we shouldn't contact each other, but...”
“Eh, Shizuku? Did you stay up late again today?”
“Come on, you shouldn't stay up this late...”
“Well, if you don't mind, do you want something to eat?”
“It's okay, I usually do it myself.”
Kasumi is currently facing away from me, cooking something in a pot.
A delicious smell keeps wafting towards me, making me a little hungry.
On the table is a plate of...
“Sometimes it turns out like this... B-But the taste hasn't changed, and thanks to your guidance, it's become even more delicious!”
“Great, then come and have a drink with me.”
“Well, it smells good, and the crispy dried fish taste great.”
“Hehe, wonderful. This is my best dish.”
“Hmph... I said not to worry about it!”
“This is the first time I've had a drink with someone this late who's not family.”
“No, they just drink milk or juice.”
“I usually drink with Shizuku. After we moved here she's been staying up late.”
“Do you drink this much when you're with Shizuku too?”
“Why do you want me to know?”
“I've already made up my mind... it's better not to dwell on the past.”
“Going back is not a wise choice.”
“Why won't he just look at me a little more...”
“W-Why does it sound like he's not a good person...?”
“Ayano and Shizuku say the same thing...”
“Hehe... Now I can drink even more!”
“There's no benefit in pretending to be strong for you.”
“Compared to you, he doesn't have any good qualities...”
“He can't do housework and he's arrogant. Besides being good-looking, there's nothing else...”
“And there are so many women around him...”
“Grrrrr... The more I talk, the angrier I get...
In less than half an hour, the table is filled with empty bottles and cans.
Kasumi's true self is making me a bit scared.
I get up and pour a cup of hot water from the water dispenser, placing it in front of Kasumi.
“But... because you're an outsider, I can say all this to you.”
“Although Ayano and Shizuku know about my situation, I pretend to be strong in front of them...”
“I don't want them to see me being foolish... *gulp*...”
“He was a sweet talker when we first met...”
“Do you want me to help you back to your room?”
“...Hey, I want to hear your opinion as an outsider.”
“Yeah... Is that what you think too?”
“And besides, Kasumi has more important things to do now.”
“Isn't it about making important people happy with your cooking?”
“There are still two people waiting for you here, you know.”
“You idiot... If I learn how to cook, then you won't have a job anymore...”
After that, Kasumi doesn't say anything and I can hear her breathing getting heavier.
This is the first time I've seen Kasumi like this.
That guy really doesn't know how to appreciate such a wonderful woman...
If it were me... If only it were me...
I'd make her happy for sure.
“...*huff*... What should I do with her now...”
After covering Kasumi with a blanket, I hesitate about what to do next.
It doesn't seem right to leave Kasumi alone in the kitchen and go back to my room.
I go back to my chair and quietly lie down.
My mind falls into a deep sleep.
“It seems like I relaxed a bit too much last night...”
“And my head feels a bit dizzy...”
A soft whisper reaches my ears, gradually bringing me back to consciousness.
But my body still can't move. I feel incredibly heavy. Is it because of the alcohol?
“That's the first time I've complained like that to you.”
Suddenly, a warm, comfortable sensation touches my head, causing my slowly recovering mind to calm down.
“Why would I want a man who's always looking for something else?”
“Plus, there's more than two people who need me. Now there's three~”
“But I have to prepare it before Ayano, Shizuku, and you wake up!”
The table suddenly shakes, snapping me back to consciousness.
It seems like Kasumi is currently enduring the pain, whispering to herself in a low voice.
Sounds like Kasumi bumped into the table... but judging by her reaction... Did she stub her toe?
